pin.beschrijving: "Indulge in a flavorful Mediterranean pasta dish featuring tangy feta cheese, fresh spinach, garlic, and burst cherry tomatoes in every bite.  Ingredients: - 8 oz pasta - 1 cup crumbled feta cheese - 2 cups fresh spinach - 3 cloves garlic, minced - 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved - 2 tbsp olive oil - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to package instructions. Drain and set aside. 2. In a pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add minced garlic and sauté until fragrant. 3. Add cherry tomatoes and cook until they start to soften. 4. Toss in fresh spinach and cook until wilted. 5. Add cooked pasta to the pan and mix well. 6. Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese over the pasta and stir until melted. 7. Season with salt and pepper to taste. 8. Serve hot and enjoy the Mediterr
